suggested_requirements.text: GOG shall provide Catalogue, Main Database (MDB) and final mission data.
GOG shall use the GaiaSimu library and the Gaia Tools library.
GOG shall support source generation from the Universe Model or an Object Input Catalogue.
GOG shall process data source by source.
GOG shall allow users to select whether to add instrumental and reduction noise effects.
GOG shall accept user-defined values for noise effects.
GOG shall use the I/O Catalogue format defined in the Interface Control Document for the Gaia Main Database.
GOG shall produce identical results for identical input configuration parameters.
GOG shall provide a command line interface for execution.
GOG shall be deployable as a standalone Java jar file.
GOG shall be capable of running in cluster or grid environments.
GOG shall support single-threaded execution mode.
GOG shall be platform independent across LINUX, UNIX, and MAC.
GOG shall process one complete source in 2 CPU seconds.
The Initialisation Module shall read input source information from the Universe Model or user-provided sources.
The Initialisation Module shall include information on the Galaxy, SkyBackground, Extinction Law, and DMS models.
The Initialisation Module shall include information on the instrument model, including scanning law, dead time, and noise models.
The Initialisation Module shall include information on the reduction model, including instrument effects subtraction and scientific content extraction noise.
The Initialisation Module shall define output specifications including spectrum, astrometry, radial velocity, physical parameters, and epoch counts.
The Epoch Parameters module shall calculate astrometric parameters including transit times and field angles with instrumental and reduction errors.
The Epoch Parameters module shall calculate epoch photometry including G, GRP, GBP, and GRVS magnitudes.
The Epoch Parameters module shall calculate epoch radial velocity.
The Epoch Parameters module shall determine epoch flags and physical parameters.
The Combined Parameters module shall compute astrometric combined data, including parallax, proper motion errors, covariance matrix, and estimated errors.
The Combined Parameters module shall determine combined photometry, mean radial velocity, final flags, and mean physical parameters.
The Spectrum Simulation Module shall calculate flux noise, CCD combination noise, wavelength calibration, and multi-transit combination noise.
The Output Module shall write universe catalog output data according to the universe model ICD.
The Output Module shall format output data according to the MDB data model.
